scope: Published method design and source identity/condition linkage only; no viability/rank, synergy, protein or clinical response numbers

assay.primary_material: Freshly excised tissue digested; cells immediately treated or cultured. Established PDC means logarithmic growth beyond third passage. Patient-specific passage, purity, prior therapy and preparation crosswalk not publicly established.
assay.panel: 12 drugs, three subject-response dose levels IC0/IC10/IC20; panel includes cytotoxic/epigenetic/kinase agents. These are design levels, not measured EMC responses.
assay.design: 155 OACD experimental combinations in technical duplicates; dose-response assays run in parallel. Technical duplicates are not independent patients.
assay.readout: CellTiter-Glo luminescent viability at 48 h; normalized cell viability is regression input. Raw luminescence, normalized assay input, fitted second-order predicted outputs and drug ranks are distinct quantities.
assay.dose_and_control_limits: Individual per-sample actual concentrations, normalization denominator/control input, failed-condition/missingness, replicate covariance and raw condition matrix not recovered. General design is not an actual EMC dose/replicate/control record.
assay.quality: Methods name Z-factor and strictly standardized mean difference; no native EMC quality or LOD inference, no numerical outcome inspection.

public_data: Phenotypic drug-sensitivity dataset is corresponding-author reasonable request only. Public figures include plotted known QPOP response/rank summaries, but no authenticated EMC case or all-condition raw/matched clinical matrix identified. Source repair does not make it new data.
null_semantics: No authenticated EMC condition established, not proof actual EMC absent from cohort or no assays exist.
